title: Create a Quran video
subtitle: Choose your verses, reciter and design. Preview your recitation, then export a video.
reciter-help: Prepare the preview to check this reciter's recording and ayah timings. Play it to hear the selected passage.
upload-help: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MiB. H.264 MP4 up to 50 MiB and 180 seconds. Maximum dimension 4096 px.
muted-background: Background sound is muted. Only the recitation is heard.
preview-help: Set up your passage, then prepare the preview.
source-note: Quran text, fonts and reciters come from Tilawa's existing content sources.
paused: Video generation is currently paused. Saved projects remain available.
guest-retention: Guest projects, videos and uploads expire after 24 hours in this browser.
member-retention: Projects are kept for 30 days after saving. Videos and uploads expire after 7 days.
sign-in: Sign in for longer projects and more exports.
claim-help: A guest project was saved in this browser. You can explicitly copy it into your account. Guest uploads retain their original ownership; upload your background again if needed.
claim: Copy guest project to my account
empty-library: Your saved projects and exported videos will appear here.
delete-confirm: Delete this project and its generated videos?

errors.STUDIO_ERROR: The studio could not complete this request. Please try again.
errors.STUDIO_NOT_CONFIGURED: The video studio is being prepared and is not available yet.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Connection interrupted. Check your connection and try again.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This file or project is unavailable in your current session.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This project or file has expired or is unavailable.
errors.CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE: Quran content could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the selected settings and ayah range.

errors.TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE: The selected translation is unavailable for this passage.

errors.FONT_DATA_UNAVAILABLE: The source does not provide the required glyphs for this font.
errors.FONT_VERSION_MISMATCH: The font asset failed verification. Prepare the preview again.
errors.ASSETS_UNAVAILABLE: The studio's verified asset library is not ready yet.
errors.ASSETS_VERSION_MISMATCH: The studio's assets need updating before export.
errors.TEXT_OVERFLOW: An ayah or translation exceeds the available space. Reduce text size or choose a wider format.
errors.DURATION_LIMIT: This passage exceeds your duration limit. Choose fewer ayahs.

errors.GLOBAL_LIMIT: The studio has reached today's output limit. Please return after the reset.
errors.RATE_LIMIT: Too many requests. Please wait a minute.

errors.AUTOMATION_AI_LIMIT: Today's AI request budget is used. It resets at midnight UTC.

automation.title: Automatic Quran videos
automation.subtitle: Workers AI chooses the passage, reciter, image, translation and design. Videos are saved in your library.
automation.private: This page is available only to the configured Tilawa account. Sign in with that account.
automation.schedule: Two videos daily at 09:00 and 14:00, with an optional third at 19:00 (Africa/Cairo). Each recording is 30–70 seconds.
automation.decisions: Selections use Tilawa's verified sources. Recent passages are excluded. Video generation does not publish to social networks.
automation.pause-help: Pausing stops new selections and exports. Cancel an export already running from your library.
automation.run-help: Generate now uses one of today's slots, shares your normal quota, and respects the five-hour interval.
